label: PAX5::JAK2

sections.text: PAX5 encodes a paired-box transcription factor required for B-cell identity.
JAK2 encodes a nonreceptor tyrosine kinase that transduces cytokine-receptor signals.
The fusion retains the JAK2 tyrosine-kinase region and removes normal amino-terminal control, producing constitutive JAK-STAT signaling. PAX5::JAK2 is a kinase-activating lesion in Ph-like B-ALL.
JAK inhibition has experimental activity in JAK2-fusion-positive ALL models; this evidence is investigational for PAX5::JAK2 leukemia.
